تهتلكين (form VIII)
# تَهْتَلِكِينَ (tahtalikīna) /tah.ta.li.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# تُهْتَلَكِينَ (tuhtalakīna) /tuh.ta.la.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
